reviews.text: Great selection,  all canadien and good service.
My dog ​​looks so handsome in his matching harness and leash 😍 …
I needed to buy a product for my cat and Vince was a great help. Strongly recommend this place for either cats or dogs.
My girl loves it here. Must be the great vibes. Freeze dried salmon treats are top!

We’ve been doing our pet related shopping here since 2020 when we used to live in Griffintown. Even after moving out of Griffintown we still make the drive to come shop here for our pets’ food and any other needs. The staff is always extremely knowledgeable about pet nutrition and care. Additionally, they are super welcoming and we consider the folks at Pawse friends (especially Chad).
Broad assortment of pet product that the owners stand by. The staff can speak to any item on their shelves. Awesome folks to support!
Really liked the service. Very honest. Thank you
Great customer service. Made me aware of a inexpensive alternative to veterinary dental care cat food.

Incredible little store with everything you need for your dog! Really thoughtful selection of products and they bring in unique items from smaller companies. Owners and employees are so kind and knowledgeable. Online orders for delivery or pickup is super convenient too!
I only go there for my dog's toys and accessories. The shop is small and has the best selection of products!

Absolutely wonderful experience! The staff is incredibly kind and welcoming, and you can immediately see how much they genuinely care about the animals. My dog came back relaxed, perfectly groomed, and clearly well-treated. The facility is clean, organized, and has a warm atmosphere. I will definitely be returning and highly recommend this place to all pet owners.
Great pet store inn a cool part of town
Excellent service! A real find for me. I loved dealing with someone who truly knew their products. I will definitely be back.
Super knowledgeable, great products, awesome owners and staff. They always have what we need for our pets. Love em.

Pawse has the most kind, helpful staff you could ask for. They clearly love what they do. This is a super convenient spot that also does same-day delivery that can be a lifesaver! They helped me choose this rainbow toy that my cat practically tore my bag apart to get to. I couldn't even get the tag off he was so into it!
A+ service

We got amazing help while at Pawse. They were really patient and knowledgeable about their products. They helped us fit our dog with Canada Pooch Suspender Boots and a doggie sweatshirt. I highly recommend going. We plan on going back the next time we are in town! Merci beaucoup!!
The advisor I spoke to on Sunday was extremely knowledgeable. He gave excellent advice and was courteous (he even opened the door for me). Impeccable service.
Good selection of products
Excellent service, especially the very convenient delivery!
The most knowledgable staff I have ever seen.

They were playing The Specials in store so they get my vote 😁

They were super nice too, prices seem reasonable. Not the biggest selection of stuff but they had what I need. …
Excellent advice and a very pleasant shopping experience.

I’ve been desperately looking for a dog spray to prevent ticks and fleas, but based on essential oils. I called soo many different stores and all of them had only chemical sprays. This was the only one that had a natural one! They offer different sort of preventative care against ticks and fleas, combs, brushes, natural dog food. Besides, the service was very good and we received so many samples of the dog food to try! Thank you so much! Highly recommended!
Normally good service but today ,they show opened and I drove there and shop is closed without any explanations .Will have to buy else where

Both their products and the staff are incredible ! I have a high energy herding dog that can easily get bored. They’ve introduced me to so many methods of enrichment all while remaining in my budget. Highly recommend !

So thankful for them! The products are curated with so much love and thought. Everything is top notch as they really do their research. The team is patient, knowledgeable and helpful. Thank you Pawse!
Amazing local pet shop, the staff are very helpful
